subject: prd/planner-driven-model-routing
statement: When a routing attempt reaches its terminal resolution or worker outcome, the system shall retain its bounded decision/outcome evidence as an immutable, append-only event record in git.
rationale: routing judgments and failures are the improvement fuel for successor policy
fit_criterion: exact, promoted, unsupported, verified, failed, and blocked fixtures each create a new committed evidence record; reruns never overwrite an earlier record; records contain no prompt or code payload
